apps.name: RagaMentor
apps.versionDescription: v1.5.27 — Scrolling the song page while a song plays is smooth again: the playhead stream no longer rebuilds the loops list and the waveform peaks are drawn once, not twenty times a second. The Raga Browser lists also sit at the standard spacing under the pills now.
apps.localizedDescription: RagaMentor native: LoopLab — slow down songs, keep pitch, loop sections. Built by GitHub Actions + fastlane on every push to main.
